 SRB-MRT
MITSUBISHI
Introduction

This 
document describes inspection and maintenance methods 
which must be performed on a daily/monthly 
bases, D1/M1 as indicated in the above title block. Oil 
& winding and ambient temperature, load current and oil level in 
 transformer should be daily checked and recorded.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar tested by eng. Nafad 
 Kamel Mahmoud, revised by UEEPC Quality control general director eng. Gamal 
 Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab: Head sector of El-Kureimat PS.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area.

Wear the appropriate 
 safety equipment as safety shoes, helmet,

sections.text: Environmental Recommendation

items:
Don't burn the cloth used in 
 cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.

Fix any oil leaks to prevent 
 pollution and save money of wasted oil.

sections.text:
Oil leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil 
and ground water and eventually on the ecosystem. "It takes only 1 liter of 
Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 1,000,000 liters of potable water 
useless for human consumption
Tools and Equipment

items: Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.

Complete tool kit/set, including a 
 torque wrench.

sections.text: Work to be carried out
At least item 1 should be checked Daily and Recorded

Check oil temperature and winding temperature by 
reading indications of thermometers and winding 
thermal relays. Compare them with the data previously obtained 
.

If oil or winding temperature are much higher or 
lower-considering load current and ambient temperature, thermometers should be 
inspected. The finned area of radiators and the inner surface of cooling water 
should be cleaned.

Load 
current and ambient temperature should be recorded at the same time.

Check Oil level in transformer and in bushing by
 reading the indication of the dial oil level gauge 
on the conservator.

Compare it with oil level-oil temperature curve 
for the transformer.

When the indicated oil level is constant with the 
changing oil temperature, inspect the dial gauge and check the actual oil level.

Check the oil level in bushing with the oil level 
gauge.

Check 
oil leaks visually from radiators, flanges, pipes and transformer tank.

If oil leaks due to gasket, tighten bolts 
or exchange 
gasket.

If oil from welded parts apply adhesive material 
or weld again on the leaking parts.

Listen 
carefully to abnormal or unusual noise especially from oil pump motors and fan 
motors, if there is any noises exchange the bearing with new ones.

Check any abnormal vibration by your hand, if 
there is any vibration due to loose bolts, tighten them.
Confirm tightness of bolts with a test hammer.

Check visually that all connections are normal 
without any discoloration due to local heating .

Inspect visually for dust especially on radiators 
because it may reduce cooling capacity of radiators

Inspect visually for rust, especially on radiators 
and repainting if necessary.

Inspection visually for dew in the terminal box, 
control cabinet and protective relays, if any dew found, dry it down and ensure 
space heaters in use.

sections.text: Daily inspection items of tab changer
Tab changer main body

Indication of oil gauge, 
check to see if the oil level far beyond the upper or lower limit and add oil in 
case of the indication of the lower limit.

Color of the silica gel in the breather, in 
case of dark blue, it is good, check to see if it has turned into pink, replace 
or dry the desiccative when it has turned pink.

Color and level of the oil in the breather pot,
check to see if the oil level is up to the red line, replace the oil when it 
is below the red line or it is contaminated.

Head case and piping, check that no oil 
leakage.

sections.text: Driving mechanism
Operating counter

Record 
the number of operations.

Check to see that the number of operations is excessively larger 
or smaller, in case of automatic operation, more than 50 operations per day is 
too large, in case of an excessive number of operations, readjusting the 
sensitivity of the voltage regulating relay is necessary.
